subject: Identity platform renewal and device-posture scope
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: David Sanders <david.sanders@okta.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Identity platform renewal and device-posture scope

David —

We’re coming up on our annual renewal window for our identity platform (contract ends 2026-08-15). Before we jump into pricing, I want to confirm scope for two items that will affect seat licensing and add-on fees: device-posture enforcement for managed laptops and our SSO/MFA baseline.

Quick context: since last renewal our usage has grown ~28% (attached quarterly usage export), and we’ve added a pilot of device-posture for our security team (disk encryption + MDM signal). Security is asking for posture checks to be enforced for contractor and employee classes, which may change the add-on tier.

Please send:
- Current renewal quote and line-item pricing for device-posture add-on (per-device vs per-seat)
- Latest SOW for renewal (we’ll likely need a short SOW that calls out device-posture scope)
- Typical lead time for implementing posture at scale (we target completion by 2026-09-30)

I’ve CC’d Lauren (security lead) and Rishi (platform) to keep them in the loop. Happy to do a 30-min sync if it’s easier than back-and-forth.

Attachments:
- redwood-usage-report-Q2.csv (tokenization & seat counts)

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Sanders <david.sanders@okta.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, renewals@okta.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Identity platform renewal and device-posture scope

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the context and the usage file. Attached are two files that should help: a draft renewal SOW (Okta_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf) and a device-posture pricing workbook (device-posture-pricing.xlsx). Highlights:

- Baseline SSO/MFA (Standard): unchanged line item; price per active user/month.
- Device Posture: we can offer either per-managed-device licensing or a bundled per-seat option. Given your device count in Q2, the per-device model looks about 12% cheaper at current scale.
- We can extend a 7% enterprise renewal discount if you sign before 2026-07-15.

Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) For contractors, do you want posture enforcement identical to employees, or a lighter posture check?
2) Do you expect to onboard BYOD devices into posture in the next 12 months?

If it helps, I can set up a 30-min pricing review with our renewal specialist and a solutions engineer. If you want to push for stronger commercial terms we typically need procurement looped in (PO/DocuSign) and a short redline to the SOW.

Attachments:
- Okta_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (draft)
- device-posture-pricing.xlsx

Best,
David Sanders
Enterprise Renewals Manager
Okta
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Identity platform renewal and device-posture scope

Looping in some internal guidance after I reviewed the SOW and pricing workbook.

Notes:
- Security position: require full posture enforcement for corporate-managed laptops; for contractors we can accept a reduced posture (endpoint risk + MDM check but not file-encryption enforcement).
- Budget: finance will target a mid-point between per-device and per-seat pricing. We should counter asking Okta for a 10% increase in discount (so 17% total) given our growth and multi-year commitment (2 years).
- Implementation: platform team (Rishi) wants a 6-week rollout window for posture if Okta provides an implementation plan and one solutions lead on-site (or remote daily check-ins).

Action items for Evelyn:
1) Ask Okta to produce a redlined SOW addressing contractor posture and implementation SLAs.
2) Loop procurement and provide PO terms we need (termination language, MSA linkage).

If procurement is ready to own negotiations I’ll step back to support technical scope.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Information Security
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: David Sanders <david.sanders@okta.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Okta renewal — procurement redlines and timeline

David —

Thanks for the draft SOW and pricing. Procurement is prepared to move but we require a few contract-level changes before routing for signature:

Requested redlines (attached):
- Term: 24 months with automatic renewal removed (we want explicit opt-in at renewal).
- Termination: 30-day termination for convenience at enterprise (not standard for Okta drafts).
- Data access & audit logs: include a clause for retention of audit logs for 18 months and secure transfer on request.
- Implementation SLA: Okta to provide a named solutions engineer and weekly status reports during rollout.

I’ve attached a redlined SOW (Okta_Renewal_SOW_v3_redline.docx). Please confirm Okta can accept the termination language and the 18-month audit log retention. Also provide a DocuSign link for the MSA + SOW if terms are accepted — procurement prefers DocuSign for PO flow.

Timeline: if Okta can accept these points we can finalize and sign within two weeks (target signature by 2026-06-29). Please call out any legal approvals needed on your side.

Attachments:
- Okta_Renewal_SOW_v3_redline.docx

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: David Sanders <david.sanders@okta.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, renewals@okta.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Okta renewal — SOW and DocuSign link

Evelyn / Neha —

Thanks for the redlines and the clear timeline. We reviewed internally and can accept the following:
- 24-month term (no auto-renew) — accepted.
- 30-day termination for convenience — accepted with a pro-rated refund on prepaid amounts.
- Audit log retention of 18 months — accepted.
- Named solutions engineer and weekly rollout reports — Okta will assign a Solutions Lead; name to follow in the DocuSign envelope.

Commercials: we can move to a 15% renewal discount (final) and we will honor the per-device pricing model in the attached final SOW. Please note the 7% early-sign incentive window ended; this is our best renewal price.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/Okta-RNW-342
Attachments included in the envelope: Okta_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf, final_pricing_breakdown.xlsx

Evelyn — if that timeline works I’ll send the envelope now so you can route for signature.

Best,
David Sanders
Enterprise Renewals Manager
Okta
